_comment: Plan options for the demo, all in East Harlem (ZIP 10029). NOTE THE SHAPE: a and b are the SAME TIME in different places (isolates the shade lever); a and c are the SAME PLACE at different times (isolates the timing lever). Compare 4:30pm to 7am at a different place and the attribution collapses to ~96% air temperature, because at 7am there is no sun for canopy to block -- the route looks worthless. canopy_shade is a stand-in from Street Tree Census density within 50 m; replace with a live Socrata query (tools/canopy.py TODO). where_label_near is used instead of where_label when the user geocoded a real address: both places are then evaluated at THAT lat/lon, so canopy_shade is the only thing differing between them. Justified because a street and a shaded path a block apart fall in the same Open-Meteo grid cell anyway.

places.where_label: Park loop — north end, shaded path
